dispositions.answer:

Eternal/Ultimate retain V/S/M-or-F; the other four retain V/S/F. No costly/consumed material is invented. Actual class ability/PB and acquired bonuses supply attacks/DCs. A supplied finite player-character fixture proves only its declared choices, not campaign possession.

Determine legality and pre-cast price first; then spend actual Action, RP, components and concentration transition before cast-time counters and hidden outcomes. First distinct prepared Wizard family waives BASE strain only, not Refrain: rank9 base strain2, consecutive same-name Refrain increments through3, different name resets that consecutive count but not used-family history. Dissonance price uses the pre-cast value. All failure/counter/suppression results retain payment/cadence and displaced concentration. No generic upcast, free cast, resource proc or second counter window follows a reflected branch, suppression resumption or component cleanup. Readying an Action spell uses the existing paid preparation/concentration/Reaction-release contract, expiry before next own regular start; ten-minute Eternal Ward cannot be generically Readied.

Each application records castId, original caster/class/school/rank, paid resource history, actual geometry and recipients, establishment timestamp, original absolute deadline or explicit source-relative clock, source concentration owner, independently removed components and consumed event IDs. Half-open absolute lifetimes exclude the deadline. Regular actor starts/ends are independent of spell events: refresh Reaction/budgets, tick recharge, expire Ready, perform actual required death saves and due effects in accepted order. No pulse, load, extra Action or menu grants a turn. No invented die outcomes: finite declared rolls are authored test inputs, never observations. A missing required outcome leaves that transition held.

dispositions.answer: NEW six distinct native functions, each independently addressable at rank9, all sharing the permanent parent. E1 Aegis: recognized creatures whose whole body is in operative volume gain+2 flat AC; strongest applicable flat bonus only (actual Armor of Faith+3 wins, never+5). E2 Shelter: those creatures have resistance to each actually typed incoming damage packet, one halving after immunity under current damage order, not a second stacked resistance and not post-defense transferred damage. It does not prevent independent riders or direct death. E3 Resolve: those creatures have advantage on an existing save against a newly applied detrimental condition/control rider; it grants no new save and no automatic cure, and ordinary advantage/disadvantage arbitration applies. E4 Threshold: unrecognized voluntary ordinary locomotion through operative volume is difficult terrain, using actual spent movement cost; it is not hard turn denial, forced-movement reduction, a physical wall or a teleport ban. E5 Veil: unrecognized observers' ordinary vision through operative interior is heavily obscured; recognized observers ignore this veil only, not darkness, actual walls or independent invisibility. No blocking of air/sound/matter or spell line of effect. E6 Watch: each actual unrecognized body entry from outside into operative volume, at most once per continuous identity/numbered round across Eternal Wards, grants a six-second visible outline while inside; it reveals position through this ward's veil but not physical total cover, hidden allegiance or the body for unrelated sight-required spells. No damage, autonomous attack, unprinted lock or borrowed free spell repertoire is added. Existing occupants at establishment are not entry events.
